title: A presentable generator with a prescribed small cardinal bound
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal V$. Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category relative to $\mathcal V$, with $\mathcal V$-small Hom sets [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], and let $X$ be a $\mathcal V$-small set. There exist an object $G\in\mathcal A$ and an infinite regular cardinal $\kappa\in\mathcal V$ such that $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(G,-)$ is faithful, $|X|<\kappa$, and $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(G,-)$ preserves all $\mathcal V$-small $\kappa$-filtered colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Thus $G$ is a generator and is $\kappa$-presentable. Here $\kappa$-filtered means that every diagram with fewer than $\kappa$ morphisms admits a cocone, and infinite regular means that a union of fewer than $\kappa$ sets, each of cardinality less than $\kappa$, has cardinality less than $\kappa$. The bound and presentability are both relative to the original universe $\mathcal V$.
